purpose: Teach: 立たさ/公布/蜂起/死傷/迎撃/内包/輩出/わいせつ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時に立たされた人々の証言を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — in your paper, you addressed the testimonies of people who lived through wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, open curiosity. Gentle lift on the question. Genuinely interested in the work, not testing. Patient pause after her name, inviting the student in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、新憲法公布の過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the process of promulgating the new Constitution.
lines.style: Direct, earnest response. Steady eye contact. Clear voice, no apologizing for the topic choice. Slight emphasis on 'Constitution' — she's proud of the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代の市民蜂起の事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined modern examples of civilian uprisings in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, drawing out the thread. Not leading — genuinely reflecting back what she's heard. Slight pause before the question, as if thinking through the connection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、災害死傷統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed disaster casualty statistics and what they revealed.
lines.style: Confident, concrete. No hedging. Speaks as though she's explained this before and trusts it holds up. Slight precision on 'statistics' — the data matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代戦の迎撃戦術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Modern defensive tactics in wartime — you covered that as well, I take it?
lines.style: Engaged, almost conversational. Genuine interest in how the topics connect. Light, searching tone — wanting to understand her research arc.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、社会システムに内包される矛盾を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I explored the inherent contradictions embedded in social systems.
lines.style: Steady, intellectual confidence. Speaks with the precision of someone who's thought this through. Slight weight on 'contradictions' — it's the core of her argument.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 名門校が輩出した人物史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And prominent schools — the notable figures they've produced — that was the focus of another piece, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, connecting dots aloud. Gentle, not interrogating. A teacher thinking alongside the student about the trajectory of her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、わいせつ表現規制の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the history of obscenity regulations and censorship.
lines.style: Final affirmation, clear and measured. Slight closure in the tone — the last answer. Poised, unflinching about the sensitive topic. Ends with quiet confidence.
